rationale: Independent closure gate. Frozen copies of exact SQL/physical expectations prevent upstream child fixture mutation from silently changing parent signoff. DuckDB and public API execution MUST independently corroborate every mandatory row.
source_identity: physical_relation#zero_based_index; joined pair l#i|r#j; original id VARCHAR remains a physical source column
mandatory_policy: all portable cases exact with typed terminal domains and complete source/output bags; FILTER dialect parse exceptions classified; no residual mandatory semantics
conditional_policy: parser error or typed residual only; native vendor engine not certified; owner TASK-124; pending maintainer release disposition
source_terminal_oracle: DuckDB complete source snapshot, SQL full output bag, and canonical exact physical-source proof
